title: AI Risk Register
description: Structured output from the ai-risk-assessment skill (owned by Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Security Engineer). Applies NIST AI RMF 1.0 (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage), the NIST AI 600-1 GenAI Profile, EU AI Act risk classification, and OWASP ASI alignment. A living delivery artifact maintained across the AI system lifecycle; consumed by Product Manager, Technical Architect, Security Engineer, and Agent Coordinator before delivery commitment.

register_id.description: Unique identifier. Convention: airr-NNN-slug or system slug.

assessor.description: Role or person accountable for the assessment.

system_context.description: NIST AI RMF Map function - system contextualization.

dependency_chain.description: Models, APIs, third-party services relied upon.

governance.description: NIST AI RMF Govern function - accountability and oversight.

eu_ai_act.description: EU AI Act classification. Determine before writing acceptance criteria.

target_compliance_date.description: High-risk standalone: 2027-12-02; embedded in products: 2028-08-02. Article 50 transparency + GPAI: 2026-08-02.

nist_600_1_risks.description: NIST AI RMF Measure function keyed to the AI 600-1 GenAI Profile.

categories.description: Assessment of the 12 GenAI risk categories relevant to this system.

agentic.description: Extension for agentic AI systems (autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows).

action_reversibility_audit.description: Irreversible actions require explicit human approval gates.

system_context.intended_use: Classify and route inbound support tickets
system_context.dependency_chain: Internal LLM gateway, category taxonomy service

governance.human_oversight_mechanism: HITL gate on refund/credit/account-closure categories; confidence-gated auto-routing
governance.escalation_path: Product Manager decides on risk acceptance

eu_ai_act.classification_rationale: Assistive classification with human oversight on high-stakes categories; not an Annex III use case

nist_600_1_risks.hallucination_threshold: Auto-route only above 0.80 confidence; below routes to human queue
nist_600_1_risks.model_degradation_signal: 7-day rolling classification accuracy < 0.90 triggers model review
nist_600_1_risks.data_privacy_classification: internal - ticket text may contain PII
nist_600_1_risks.ip_risk: Provider model; no customer data used for training

categories.mitigation: Quarterly bias audit on routing outcomes by locale
Region-pinned inference; no content in telemetry by default

agentic.action_reversibility_audit: Routing is reversible (re-queue); no irreversible actions performed by the classifier

owasp_asi_alignment.mitigation: Treat retrieved ticket context as untrusted; no instruction execution from ticket body

agentic.cascading_failure_analysis: Model unavailability degrades to deterministic keyword router; no downstream auto-actions

residual_risks.risk: Gradual model drift on new product categories
